technical_and_design_decisions: U1: Add a new UNDEPLOYED value to the Mesos SPI deployment-state enum and map the relevant Mesos task states (e.g., staged-but-not-running / killed-before-start) to it, keeping UNKNOWN as the fallback mapping for unrecognized states.

U2: Expose the existing RabbitBindingCleaner through a new secured REST controller endpoint (admin-level path, e.g., POST/DELETE under the management API) rather than modifying the cleaner itself; reuse existing security configuration for authorization.

U3: Optimize the YARN deployer by parallelizing module pushes within a stream deployment and caching/reusing application artifacts and container allocations, without changing the deployer's public SPI contract.
U4: Upgrade Spring for Apache Hadoop to 2.2.1 GA (explicitly not 2.3.0) to retain older Hive support and avoid breaking changes, updating the dependency via the build's version property/BOM.
U5: Upgrade Spring Integration to 4.2.2 GA via dependency management only; no API usage changes expected, verified by regression tests.

U6: Change the Kafka message bus binder so that a configured partition key expression is honored even when a module has a single downstream instance (partition count of 1), enabling native Kafka partitioning and ordering.
U7: Upgrade Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Build parent/BOM revisions centrally in the build files and resolve any resulting deprecation warnings or test failures.
U8: Address the HSQL DB composed-job limitation through reference documentation only (asciidoc in-repo docs); no code changes.
All new code includes unit tests; REST and binder changes additionally include integration tests using existing test infrastructure.
assumptions: The codebase is an existing Spring Cloud Data Flow / Spring Cloud Stream-family multi-module Maven project (stories reference XD port, binders, YARN/Mesos deployers), and I have full access and working familiarity with it.

The increment targets the existing release train baseline consistent with the stories (Boot 1.3-era, SHDP 2.2.x, SI 4.2.x on JDK 8); the Spring Framework 6 / Java 17 preamble is generic background and does not change the increment's baseline.
Test infrastructure already exists and is usable: local or containerized RabbitMQ and Kafka, an accessible YARN cluster for U3 validation, and a functioning CI pipeline.

Estimates are pure development effort in work-hours for a single developer and include design, coding, unit/integration testing, and self-review rework; they exclude elapsed-time effects (wait for CI, reviews by others, meetings).
Dependency upgrades (U4, U5, U7) require no application code changes beyond resolving minor deprecations or test adjustments; any larger break would be flagged as out of scope.
Documentation updates are made in the project's existing asciidoc reference documentation and release notes.
One REST endpoint for U2 is sufficient (no bulk/async job tracking API is required).
No external stakeholder availability or approvals are needed during implementation.

activities.activity_description: Review all eight user stories, inspect affected modules (Mesos SPI, Rabbit binder, YARN deployer, Kafka binder, build files, docs), and produce a task-level implementation plan for the increment.

activities.activity_name: U1: Add UNDEPLOYED status to Mesos SPI
activities.activity_description: Extend the Mesos SPI deployment-state model with an UNDEPLOYED status, update state mapping logic from Mesos task states, adjust any status reporting surfaces, and add/update unit tests.

activities.activity_name: U2: Implement REST API for Rabbit binder cleanup
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a secured REST endpoint that invokes the existing RabbitBindingCleaner to remove Rabbit broker artifacts (queues/exchanges), wire it into the existing controller layer and security configuration.

activities.activity_name: U2: Tests and validation for cleanup REST API
activities.activity_description: Write unit and integration tests for the cleanup endpoint against a running RabbitMQ, verify idempotency and authorization behavior, and document the endpoint briefly.

activities.activity_name: U3: Profile YARN deployer and identify bottlenecks
activities.activity_description: Measure current stream/module deployment times on a YARN cluster, identify serialization/sequential bottlenecks in the deployer path, and define the optimization approach.
Implement parallelized module deployment within a stream, caching/reuse of application artifacts, and reduced redundant container/state operations, keeping the deployer SPI unchanged.

activities.activity_name: U3: Validate optimizations on YARN cluster
activities.activity_description: Deploy representative streams on a YARN cluster, compare deployment times before/after, fix regressions, and update affected unit/integration tests.

activities.activity_name: U4: Upgrade Spring for Apache Hadoop to 2.2.1 GA
activities.activity_description: Bump SHDP version to 2.2.1 GA in build configuration, verify moved Spring/Hadoop versions, resolve any compatibility issues, and run the Hadoop-related test suites to confirm no breaking changes (older Hive support retained).

activities.activity_name: U5: Upgrade Spring Integration to 4.2.2 GA
activities.activity_description: Update the Spring Integration version to 4.2.2 GA via dependency management, run integration and binder test suites, and resolve any minor regressions.

activities.activity_name: U6: Kafka partitioning key with single downstream module
activities.activity_description: Modify the Kafka binder so a configured partition key expression is applied even when the downstream module has a single instance, enabling native Kafka partitioning and ordering; update configuration properties handling.

activities.activity_name: U6: Tests and docs for Kafka partitioning key
activities.activity_description: Add unit and integration tests validating partitioning and message ordering with a single downstream module, and update binder configuration documentation.

activities.activity_name: U7: Upgrade Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Build revisions
activities.activity_description: Update parent/BOM revisions for Spring Boot and Spring Cloud Build, resolve deprecation warnings and build issues, and run module build and test suites.

activities.activity_name: U8: Document HSQL DB limitations for composed jobs
activities.activity_description: Write reference documentation describing HSQL in-memory database limitations (concurrency, durability, multi-node behavior) when running composed jobs, with guidance on production database alternatives.
Run the full multi-module build and test suites, execute end-to-end stream deployment scenarios across affected binders and deployers, and fix integration defects arising from the combined changes.

activities.activity_name: Release notes, documentation updates, and CI adjustments
activities.activity_description: Update release notes and aggregate documentation for all stories, adjust CI build configuration for new dependency revisions, and finalize the increment for delivery.
